description: A documented comparison profile assembled from experimentally demonstrated molecular-storage timings. It is not a single integrated device and must not be interpreted as the performance of one physical system.

cold_read_ms.value_description: Approximately 30 min automated preparation plus approximately 6 min nanopore read/online decoding in the Takahashi et al. end-to-end automated DNA-storage demonstration.
cold_read_ms.comparability_note: This is a documented automated read-side workflow benchmark, not a direct measurement of a UMDI logical-block cold read.

write_ms.value_description: 43 s demonstrated generation of an arbitrary 64-bit molecular key using an acoustic liquid handler in ZAT-DNA.
write_ms.comparability_note: This is a rapid molecular assembly benchmark and is not equivalent to a complete verified UMDI WRITE transaction.

roundtrip_ms.value_description: Composite comparison obtained by adding the documented 43 s rapid-write benchmark to the 36 min automated read-side benchmark.
roundtrip_ms.citation: Composite of Takahashi et al. (2019) and ZAT-DNA (2026)
roundtrip_ms.comparability_note: This value was not measured in a single physical system. It is provided only to quantify the order-of-magnitude technology gap.

notes: DynaBytes (Jia et al., 2026) demonstrates CRUD-like molecular operations and real-time nanopore retrieval, but the publication does not provide a directly comparable sub-second host-visible READ/WRITE latency suitable for this numeric profile.
Researchers should replace this composite profile with measured values from their own hardware whenever available.
